notes: Trips per resident divides financial-year passenger trips by the resident population at 31 December, the midpoint of that year.
Passenger trips are flight stages and include trips by visitors; the rate is not the number of flights a typical resident takes.
Seat occupancy is passenger trips divided by seats flown on a route in a financial year, as in chart 11.
Route occupancy uses the 57 comparable routes and the workbook's twelve-month totals at June 2019 and June 2026.
Slope-chart label positions are spread apart for legibility; line ends show the true values.
Airport passenger movements count arrivals plus departures on scheduled domestic and regional flights; each trip is counted at both airports.
The treemap groups every trip once: the ten busiest disclosed routes, the other disclosed routes, and trips BITRE does not list by route.
Airport ranks for FY2014-15 to FY2024-25 use every airport BITRE reports; FY2025-26 uses the monthly file for the 20 busiest airports.
